summary: Implemented InsightSchema and KnowledgeStoreSchema as Zod schemas in mcp-server/src/schema/knowledge.ts, with all TypeScript types inferred from the schemas.

InsightSchema covers all required fields (id, scope, title, content, category, tags, source, created_at, confidence) plus optional fields (project_slug, updated_at, superseded_by). Scope enum enforces 'global' | 'project'. Confidence accepts any number without range enforcement (forward-looking field).
The scope === 'project' → project_slug required constraint is documented as a storage-layer responsibility, not enforced by the Zod schema, to keep the schema context-free and composable.

KnowledgeStoreSchema covers version, last_updated, next_id (nonnegative integer), and insights array. Created mcp-server/tests/schema/knowledge.test.ts with 33 tests covering all acceptance criteria: required field rejection, optional field handling, type validation, and KnowledgeStore edge cases.
All 33 new tests pass. The 3 pre-existing failures in tests/gui/ are unrelated to this WP.

summary: All 33 tests in tests/schema/knowledge.test.ts pass. Full Verification Stack executed: build check, AC verification, regression, and edge-case stress testing.
AC1: InsightSchema correctly rejects all 9 required fields when missing (parametric it.each) and accepts valid objects.

AC2: scope === 'project' → project_slug constraint is explicitly NOT enforced by the schema — documented in knowledge.ts comments and the test suite as storage-layer responsibility. Design decision is clear, consistent, and acceptable.
AC3: KnowledgeStoreSchema validated for empty insights array, next_id=0, next_id=1, next_id=42. All pass correctly.
AC4: All exports confirmed — InsightSchema, Insight, KnowledgeStoreSchema, KnowledgeStore, InsightScope all exported. Types are z.infer<> — no handwritten duplicate interfaces.
Regression: 2256 tests pass across the full suite. 3 pre-existing failures in tests/gui/ (api-client.test.ts x2, orchestrator-view.test.ts x1) confirmed out-of-scope and not introduced by WP-001.

Edge-case stress: NaN confidence rejected (Zod v3 default). Infinity confidence accepted (permissive by design — forward-looking field). Empty tags array accepted. id=0 accepted. Unknown extra fields silently stripped (Zod default). Empty string title/content accepted (no minLength constraint).

comments.note: mcp-server/src/schema/knowledge.ts: Infinity confidence is accepted (z.number() rejects NaN but allows Infinity). Consistent with 'no range enforcement' design, but storage layer should consider z.number().finite() if out-of-range values cause downstream issues.

mcp-server/src/schema/knowledge.ts: Empty string values for title, content, source, category are accepted — no z.string().min(1) constraint. Storage layer should guard against empty strings when persisting insights.
mcp-server/src/schema/knowledge.ts: id=0 is accepted (z.number().int() without .positive()). If IDs should be 1-based, consider z.number().int().positive() in a future revision.
No observations on AC violations — code is clean, well-commented, and consistent with the established Zod schema pattern in the codebase (work-package.ts, root-index.ts).

summary: PASS — mcp-server/src/schema/knowledge.ts and its test suite are clean, well-designed, and fully consistent with the established Zod schema patterns in the codebase.
Maintainability: dual export pattern (schema + z.infer<> type), well-commented design decisions, and elegant it.each parametric tests all pass bar. No unnecessary complexity.

Best Practices: no circular imports, no handwritten duplicate interfaces, InsightScope enum correctly reused inside InsightSchema. Design decision to defer scope==='project' → project_slug constraint to the storage layer is sound and clearly documented in both schema comments and the test file.
Performance: flat schema with no recursive definitions, no expensive transforms — zero concerns.

Future Context: version field enables forward-compatible migration, superseded_by enables insight deprecation, optional fields are correctly typed for extension. Schema is well-positioned for the downstream KnowledgeStoreManager (WP-002+).
